title: Local description of sections of an etale inverse image
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes and let $F$ be a sheaf of sets on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Every section of the etale inverse image $g^{-1}F$ over $T$ becomes, after an etale covering $\{T_a\to T\}$, the pullback of a section $t_a\in F(V_a)$ along a factorization $T_a\to V_a\to S$ with $V_a\to S$ etale.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof, paragraph beginning 'By construction of g_{i, small}^{-1}G'

proof.text: By the definition of the etale inverse image, $g^{-1}F$ is the sheafification of the presheaf $P$ on $T_{\Et}$ with $P(T')$ the filtered colimit over pairs $(V\to S,\,T'\to V\times_ST)$ of $F(V)$. Thus a section of $g^{-1}F$ is a section of the sheafification of this presheaf.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof, paragraph beginning 'By construction of g_{i, small}^{-1}G'

proof.text: Apply the local-section clause of sheafification to the section over $T$. There is an etale covering $\{T_a\to T\}$ and, for each $a$, an element $p_a\in P(T_a)$ whose image in the sheafification is the restriction of the original section.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof, paragraph beginning 'By construction of g_{i, small}^{-1}G'

proof.text: For each $a$, the filtered-colimit representation of $p_a$ supplies an etale object $V_a\to S$, a morphism $T_a\to V_a\times_ST$, and a section $t_a\in F(V_a)$ representing $p_a$. Composing $T_a\to V_a\times_ST$ with the projection gives a factorization $T_a\to V_a\to S$, and the image of $t_a$ in the inverse image is exactly the restriction of the original section to $T_a$. Hence the claimed local description holds.
